description: Source file implementing bus interface functions for Rbus and CCSP support, including initialization, parameter retrieval, and event registration.

methods.name: isRbusEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Rbus mode is enabled by querying rbus status.

methods.name: busInit
methods.description: Initializes bus support if not already initialized, checks Rbus status.

methods.name: getParameterValue
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value via Rbus or CCSP depending on mode.

methods.name: getProfileParameterValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple profile parameter values via Rbus or CCSP.

methods.name: freeParamValueSt
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for parameter value structures.

methods.name: registerForTelemetryEvents
methods.description: Registers for telemetry events with Rbus or CCSP.

methods.name: busUninit
methods.description: Uninitializes bus support, unregisters Rbus event listener.
